title: The ten essentials
summary: Pack these on every trip into the backcountry, even a short one.

blocks.p: Pack these on every trip into the backcountry, even a short one.

blocks.cap: Ten things that turn a bad night out into a survivable one.

list: Navigation: map, compass, and a charged phone or GPS.
Sun protection: sunglasses, sunscreen and a hat.
First aid kit, including a tourniquet.
Fire: lighter, ferro rod or waterproof matches, plus tinder.
Emergency shelter: space blanket, bivy sack or tarp.
Extra food: a day’s worth beyond the plan.
Extra water and a way to treat more.
Extra layers: insulation and rain gear.

blocks.p: Tell someone your route and when you’ll be back, and add a whistle: three blasts carries farther than shouting.
